reviews.review: This game Is loads of fun, I love it

Do I recommend this game? Yes I do. 

If you are coming from console shooters, then the pace might be way too slow for you. But I recommend you stick with it: once you get over the adjustment, you will be rewarded with some really memorable moments.  

I found my way in to this series with Arma:Gold, which still looks great to this day. They all feature the same basic framework: large open world, your choice of weapon/vehicle/aircraft and a powerful editor for creating your own missions. This is why it appeals to lots of us, because you may have had Airfix soldiers when you were younger, where you set up battles on your bed, using the folded quilt as custom topography. Arma taps into that part of you, giving you the tools to create your own stories. The only limit is your imagination.

Other reviewers here Im sure will have commented on the other game modes, so I dont think I need to review them again.

Prerequisites to enjoy this game are: 1) Patience, you need to learn the controls, and dont expect to be firing your weapon at enemies every second. You sometimes will have to travel large distance by foot. 2) A PC that exceeds the requirements. It looks fantastic. 3) Toy soldiers as a kid.

If i had to keep just one game ... this would be it
Probably the best game ive ever played

The best thing about Arma 3 is the open ended content you can play on it, and you can get on a server with 10+ of your friends and play together against the computer or other people.  The game has it's glitches (network blips) that can be mitigated by going to a strong server host / game type and making sure you are close to it geographically.   This is because the game world is huge, and you can see multiple kilometers away enemies running around and can snipe them from a distance or rocket their vehicle.

I am glad that DayZ got me interested in the Arma series as I have had a blast with them so far.
Top notch game,especially with Altis and Wastelands. 10/10 would recommend again.
